outcome: Placental-mediated complications of pregnancy (preeclampsia/eclampsia, stillbirth, fetal growth restriction/low birthweight, placental abruption)
finding: Women with chronic hypertension who conceived using ART had a significantly higher risk of placental-mediated complications compared to women with chronic hypertension who conceived without ART.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<10th percentile) considered as an outcome
